seo.title: Villa ELEA in Corfu — Private Pool Villa for Families | Aeolina Villas
seo.description: Villa ELEA is a private pool villa in Episkopiana, Corfu with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, garden and mountain views. Ideal for families and small groups.

hero.title: Villa ELEA
hero.intro: Villa ELEA is a 150 m² two-bedroom villa designed for comfort and peace. With a private pool, open terrace, and full kitchen, it’s the perfect choice for couples or families seeking a private escape in the Corfu countryside.
